name: Marmo
description: A typed component factory for building reusable UI components around class names. Marmo separates styling logic from markup through configurable variants, dynamic styles, and component composition. It supports React and SolidJS, with an experimental Astro adapter for static HTML rendering.
developmentFocus: Frontend library development, typed component APIs, reusable UI architecture, and styling ergonomics.

name: Vike Landing Page
description: An interactive landing page for the Vike web framework, contributed to the official project. Responsive layouts, animated SVG illustrations, and scroll-driven navigation explain the framework's flexibility, stability, and developer experience through an engaging technical product presentation.
developmentFocus: Creative frontend development, interaction design, responsive interfaces, web animation, and visual communication of technical concepts.
notes: Landing-page contribution within Vike's shared repository; merged in PR #3073.

name: Nivel
description: A graph-driven documentation engine and static site builder for MDX content. Nivel uses an explicit, typed structure of sections, groups, and pages to derive routes and navigation. Its reusable engine, CLI, and Vike integration connect content configuration with a customizable React documentation interface.
developmentFocus: Documentation tooling, graph-based information architecture, static site generation, and developer experience.

name: vite-beasties-output
description: A post-build adapter that uses Beasties to extract and inline critical CSS into generated HTML. Dedicated Vite and Astro integrations process final build output, making the plugin suitable for static sites and prerendered applications, including Vike builds.
developmentFocus: Frontend performance, critical CSS, build tooling, and framework integration.

name: maplibre-nextjs-ts-starter
description: A TypeScript starter for interactive MapLibre applications in Next.js. It demonstrates two marker-rendering approaches: custom React markers and native GeoJSON layers. Category-based clustering, popups, map controls, and shared application state support the development of customized mapping interfaces.
developmentFocus: Geospatial frontend architecture, marker rendering, clustering, and the trade-offs between customization and rendering performance.

name: convert-to-arrow
description: A command-line codemod for converting JavaScript and TypeScript function declarations into arrow functions. Built on ts-morph, it preserves type annotations and generics, handles exports, and skips selected cases where conversion could alter behavior or produce invalid code. Optional reports explain skipped conversions.
developmentFocus: Developer tooling, automated refactoring, static analysis, and JavaScript/TypeScript code transformation.
